text_blocks.snippet: Dexketoprofen trometamol is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) used for short-term treatment of mild to moderate pain, including dysmenorrhea, migraines, and musculoskeletal pain. It is the active enantiomer of ketoprofen and is known for its rapid onset of action and effectiveness in acute pain management.
snippet_highlighted_words: a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) used for short-term treatment of mild to moderate pain, including dysmenorrhea, migraines, and musculoskeletal pain

list.title: NSAID:
list.snippet: Dexketoprofen trometamol belongs to the NSAID family, which means it works by reducing pain, inflammation, and fever.

list.title: Active Enantiomer:
list.snippet: It is the dextrorotatory enantiomer of racemic ketoprofen, meaning it is the more active form of the drug.

list.title: Rapid Action:
list.snippet: It is known for its quick onset of pain relief, often within 30 minutes.

list.title: Acute Pain:
list.snippet: It is commonly used for acute pain conditions like postoperative pain, renal colic, and musculoskeletal pain.

list.title: Dosage Reduction:
list.snippet: By using only the active enantiomer, the dosage can be reduced compared to the racemic mixture.

list.title: Tromethamine Salt:
list.snippet: The formulation as a tromethamine salt enhances its solubility and absorption, contributing to its rapid action.

list.title: Potential Side Effects:
list.snippet: Like other NSAIDs, it can cause side effects such as gastrointestinal issues (nausea, stomach pain, diarrhea), dizziness, and headache.

list.title: Not for Long-Term Use:
list.snippet: Dexketoprofen trometamol is typically recommended for short-term treatment (up to 2 days) due to potential side effects with prolonged use.
Postoperative Pain: Effectively used to manage pain after surgery.
Musculoskeletal Pain: Provides relief from pain associated with conditions like osteoarthritis and back pain.
Dysmenorrhea: Effective in treating menstrual pain.
Migraines: Used for the relief of migraine headaches.
Renal Colic: Used to manage the pain associated with kidney stones.

list.title: Individual Variation:
list.snippet: Response to dexketoprofen trometamol can vary between individuals.

list.title: Medical Supervision:
list.snippet: It is essential to consult with a healthcare professional before using this medication, especially for individuals with pre-existing conditions or those taking other medications.

list.title: Potential for Side Effects:
list.snippet: While generally well-tolerated, potential side effects should be considered, especially with prolonged use.

list.title: Not a Substitute for Opioids:
list.snippet: While it can reduce opioid consumption in some cases, it may not be suitable for severe pain requiring opioid analgesics.
